summary: Norris hunts redemption from pole position after Russell's dominant sprint victory threatens to upset the championship favorite's Zandvoort dominance. Mercedes' momentum from George Russell's wire-to-wire sprint win sets up a fierce battle for track position, with Charles Leclerc lurking as a third-force threat in the fight for Sunday's victory. A win for Norris shores up his title buffer, while a Russell triumph or Leclerc shock result could dramatically reshape the championship narrative heading into the season's final stretch.
